_note: Equity sold intraday is outside the capital-gains head: a speculative transaction, business income, which this engine does not compute, so a bucket it reaches is refused (W-160a, D-363). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.66(31), "“speculative transaction” means a transaction in which a contract for the purchase or sale of any commodity, including stocks and shares, is periodically or ultimately settled otherwise than by the actual delivery or transfer of the commodity or scrips" (p.103), for Part D of Chapter IV (profits and gains of business). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.43(5), the same words (thc p.236), unamended in that part to AY 2026-27. Reached by capitalgains.asset = EQUITY and trade.transfer.segment = INTRADAY, the reach portfolio's TradeClassifier gave intraday (W-160a C3a). Conditions only. Every regime. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-24-speculative-transaction.md S1, S3.
